newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Applied Materials shrs fall.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Applied Materials shrs fall.

text.p: Shares of Applied Materials Inc fell 1-1/8 to 30-7/8 shortly after the company reported fourth-quarter earnings.
The company said its fourth-quarter results were $0.40 per share, including a $0.09 per share charge, compared with $0.84 per share a year earlier.
Also, the company said it expected the industry-wide downturn to continue into early 1997.
The First Call consensus estimate for Applied Materials, which supplies equipment used for making semiconductors, was $0.48 per share, excluding special charges.
Other companies in semiconductor-related business, such as Intel Corp, Micron Technology Inc and Motorola Inc, remained in line with their closing prices, traders said.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 2,800 shares compared to 3,500 shares on Wednesday. There was no session two volume compared to 8,494,300 shares on Wednesday.
